description: This file defines the AuthService class responsible for handling user authentication operations such as sign-in, sign-up with retries, sign-out, fetching current user info, and building application-specific user objects in a Flutter application using Supabase as backend.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: A service class providing authentication functionalities such as sign in, sign up with retry logic, sign out, and user profile management with Supabase.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Signs in a user with email and password.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, and role, includes retry logic with exponential backoff.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Returns the currently authenticated user or null.

methods.name: currentRole
methods.description: Retrieves the role of the current user from user metadata, defaults to 'patient'.

methods.name: fetchRoleFromProfiles
methods.description: Fetches the user's role from the 'profiles' table by user ID.

methods.name: buildAppUser
methods.description: Builds an AppUser instance from current authentication info, attempting to resolve role from profile data.
